Single-build releases with pinned provenance. Linux (x64 and arm64): built by Nix from the committed flake.lock — hermetic, locally reproducible with `nix build`; the archive bundles the dynamic loader and libraries behind the `abgen` entry script, so it runs on any Linux (glibc, musl, NixOS) with no host requirements. Windows and macOS: rust 1.97.1 (pinned), `--locked` against the committed Cargo.lock, a fixed `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH`; both Windows targets are self-contained, importing nothing but system DLLs, and macOS needs system libraries only. Each archive is self-contained: the `template/` and `shader/` assets are compiled into the binary, so there is nothing to place beside it (`ABGEN_ROOT`/`ABGEN_SHADER_BUNDLE` still override). Optional everywhere: libturbojpeg, which decodes GLB-embedded JPEG measurably closer to the upstream ab-cdn pipeline but is not bit-reproducible across platforms; `ABGEN_JPEG_GLB_9C=1` selects the deterministic vendored path instead (see PARITY.md). The same binaries publish to npm as `@dcl/abgen` (per-platform packages as optionalDependencies; `npx @dcl/abgen` runs the server).
